story_type: rescue swimmer lowered onto a fishing boat underway in its own wake, basket hoist, air-to-air view (hoist cam)
hook: He rode a cable down to a boat that never stopped.
narration: This rescue swimmer rode a cable down to a fishing boat that never stopped moving.
Seventy three miles southeast of Atlantic City, New Jersey, in August 2014.
A man aboard needed help, so a Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station Atlantic City flew out.
The boat holds its speed and heading. The pilot matches it, so the cable stays over the deck.
The swimmer got the man into the basket, and the cable lifted him clear of the wake.
Then the basket reached the cabin door.
outcome: The Atlantic City crew hoisted the man off the fishing boat.

location_card.place: 73 miles southeast of Atlantic City, New Jersey

title: Dropped onto a boat that kept going
description:
On Aug. 6, 2014, an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City hoisted a man from a fishing vessel about 73 miles southeast of Atlantic City, New Jersey.
